mod.overview: Team Aerial Combat v1.41 ([TPG]SaNTa[DTM] and Wizard_TPG, 2000-2001) tunes Base Tribes for competitive midair and aerial team combat (Anzac Gamers League defaults in TAC_Settings.cs), boosting Disc damage, shortening Grenade/Mortar fuses, doubling ELF beam range, and adding TACBot AI.
notes: Weapon & pack tuning: Disc Launcher damage jumps from 0.5 to 0.7 (40% stronger midair/splash); GrenadeLauncher totalTime drops 30 s -> 1.5 s (airburst timing); Mortar totalTime drops 30 s -> 2.5 s; ELF Gun beam doubles in length from 40 m to 80 m; Repair Pack and Shield Pack scripts adjust flight/repair interactions.

Vehicles & deployables: Scout is renamed FLPC with slower maxSpeed (50 -> 35), higher maxDamage (0.6 -> 0.8), and tighter bank/pitch (0.35/0.25); LAPC speeds up (25 -> 30); HAPC durability rises (2.0 -> 2.8); adds SpringPad.

League rules (TAC_Settings.cs, tac.cs, tacbot.cs): enforces 25 min match limits ($TAC::matchTimeLimit), controlled tourney mode, anti-llama-swap, auto-anti-TK, smurf logging, personal skin menus, and custom TACBot AI.

ScoutVehicle.summary: Renamed FLPC; slows top speed from 50 to 35, raises maxDamage from 0.6 to 0.8, and dials bank/pitch from 0.5 to 0.35/0.25.
notes: Turns the fast Base Scout into a tougher, steadier light carrier.

DiscLauncher.summary: Spinfusor disc damageValue rises from 0.5 to 0.7 (+40% damage).
notes: Rewards midair and direct hits in aerial dogfighting.

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Grenade fuse lifetime drops from 30.0 s to 1.5 s (totalTime).
notes: Forces timed airbursts and short-range engagements rather than rolling long-fuse spam.

Mortar.summary: Mortar shell max totalTime tightens from 30.0 s to 2.5 s.
notes: Caps long-range mortar arcing time to fit aerial mid-range pacing.

EnergyRifle.summary: ELF Gun beam extends from 40.0 m to 80.0 m.
notes: Doubles effective reach for slowing airborne targets.

RepairPack.summary: Includes custom Repair Pack activation/mount logic in TAC's item scripts.
notes: Works alongside TAC's airborne combat mechanics.

ShieldPack.summary: Includes custom Shield Pack script handling.
notes: Tuned for TAC's higher-damage Disc environment.
